text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 tail latency spike detected for streaming endpoints in eu-west-2 (observed 3:45pm UTC). SLO breach: p99 > 2.5s, p95 trending up. Paging oncall.
oncall-alex: I’m on it. Initial question: customer impact? are requests timing out or just slower?
sre-rita: Seeing a sharp tail at the same time window across multiple hosts. Streaming stalls (stall/restart) and increased TLS handshake timeouts. Not global, concentrated in eu-west-2 azb/azc.
netops-jay: Packet loss spike on egress NAT paths around 15:44-15:46 UTC. Dropped retransmits and SYN retransmit rate up. Suspect cross-AZ routing flap + NAT ephemeral exhaustion on a subset of boxes.
customer-success-maria: CX: two enterprise customers reported truncated streaming sessions and reconnect loops. CS ticket #CS-4521 includes logs with repeated Error: grpc deadline exceeded.
eng-runtime-sam: grabbing runtime metrics. KV cache miss rate is fine, but continuous-batching queue depths spiking on some nodes. Possible backlog -> longer tail while TCP/TLS handshakes retry.
oncall-alex: immediate mitigations: 1) enable fallback routing to eu-west-1 for new sessions, 2) increase NAT pool on affected subnet if possible, 3) temporarily raise stream timeouts to avoid double-retries. Who can flip failover?
netops-jay: I can cut a regional routing policy change to route ~20% new traffic to eu-west-1. Pushing now. Will also check conntrack counters and increase ephemeral port range where we can.
sre-rita: Running quick checks: `sudo conntrack -S | grep tcp` shows conntrack entries nearing 80% on nat-proxy-7. Also seeing `tcp_retransmits` spikes in kernel stats. Collecting pcap from nat-proxy-7 -> uploading short sample to S3.
eng-runtime-sam: To reduce pressure on TLS, enable keepalive longer and reduce new TLS handshakes by pinning long-lived connections where possible. Patching canary now: `kubectl patch deployment runtime-proxy -p '{"spec": {"template": {"spec": {"containers": [{"name":"proxy","env":[{"name":"TLS_KEEPALIVE","value":"120s"}]}}}}}'`
deploy-bot: deploy accepted for runtime-proxy patch; rollout in progress -> 3/3 pods updated in eu-west-2.
oncall-alex: Nice. Netops, any quick NAT capacity bump we can do w/o infra change window?
netops-jay: I increased ephemeral port range on nat-proxy-7 and rotated a small NAT instance pool to offload connections. Monitoring conntrack now.
sre-rita: After the routing change and NAT tweak, p99 dropped from 3.2s -> 1.6s in 4 minutes. Streaming error rate down ~70%. Still seeing intermittent stalls on a small shard.
customer-success-maria: Let me notify impacted customers: telling them we've implemented mitigations and are continuing to monitor; will follow up with RCA ETA.
pm-evan: Keep an eye on regressions — if p95 jumps again, consider automated fallback policy to switch model variants to smaller memory footprint to reduce TLS churn.
eng-runtime-sam: Added temporary caching of handshake tokens and extended idle keepalive for proxy connections. Also enabling prefix KV caching to reduce per-request work for reconnects.
oncall-alex: Planning handoff in 25m to night oncall. Notes for handoff: root cause likely cross-AZ routing + NAT conntrack saturation causing retransmits and TLS handshake spikes; mitigations applied: regional failover (~20% to eu-west-1), NAT ephemeral range expanded, runtime keepalive patched, small proxy pool rotated. Current status: p99 ~1.4s, p95 stable ~0.45s, error rate ~down 78% vs peak.
sre-rita: logs attached: short tcpdump, conntrack snapshot, `netstat -s` output, and a graph link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/streaming/egress-handshake?from=now-15m to=now. (internal link)
netops-jay: Added a short-term rule to drain traffic from nat-proxy-7 while we investigate instance-level NIC stats. Will bring it back once kernel counters clear.
oncall-alex: Tagged incident P0, creating postmortem stub. Maria — keep customers updated, collect affected org IDs. Sam/Rita/Jay — please capture exact commands and timelines for postmortem.
customer-success-maria: Posted update to affected orgs and created CS tracking spreadsheet.
oncall-alex: Handoff to night-oncall @oncall-beth in 25m. If anything spikes above p99 2.5s, page immediately. Leaving this thread open for updates. :white_check_mark:
